title: Paging for EPS services through E-UTRAN using S-TMSI

entities.name: Paging for EPS services through E-UTRAN using S-TMSI
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to page a UE for EPS services using the S-TMSI identifier over E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: S-TMSI
entities.description: Temporary mobile subscriber identity used to identify the UE in paging messages.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where it is registered with the network and can be paged.

relations.description: Paging procedure uses S-TMSI to identify the UE being paged.
Paging procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
